description: The Staten Island Republican, Conservative and Independence Parties have endorsed Michael Reilly as their candidate for the 62nd Assembly District. The parties join NYC Councilman Joseph Borelli and Minority Leader Steven Matteo in supporting Reilly for the South Shore Assembly seat. The Assembly seat is currently held by Assemblyman Ronald Casterina, who is a candidate for Surrogate Judge.
